_about: The 6 s ad's variants (Harry 2026-10-22). edl.py turns each into variants/<name>.json; assemble.py renders it. capture: a shots.json entry.

V1.desc: inn, uniform speed so the storey tour's step down to the ground floor lands at 4.75 s (the last beat before the final card), build continues unseen under the cards, baseline timing

V2.desc: inn, whole capture sped uniformly so the top floor's last piece lands at 4.8 s, build continues under the cards

V3.desc: inn, cards FREEZE the build and it resumes where it left off (control for continue-unseen)

V4.desc: inn, late final card: final reveal at 5.4 (0.6 s hold), finished inn on screen longer

V7.desc: inn, as V1 with a slow camera push-in across the whole clock (dist x0.8)

V8.desc: inn, quicker 0.25 s flashes and a 1.5 s final hold (final at 4.5)

V9.desc: control: no cuts; the inn builds uncut 0-4.4, then the final card reveals the four phrases one by one over 4.4-6.0

V10.desc: one common room (no storeys) at 1x, build continues under the cards, baseline timing

V11.desc: one common room, sped/slowed uniformly so its last piece lands at 4.8 s, build continues under the cards

_M: THE WELCOME MAT (Harry 2026-10-22): one continuous shot, no cut-ins: the words are on a printed rug in front of the door, the camera orbits ~45 deg from a corner to the front as the one-storey building spins in, the mat comes square to the frame as the building settles, the full card drops over the last 1.0 s

M1.desc: welcome mat: armoury (one storey) at 1x, high 3/4 orbit corner -> front (yaw -45 -> 0, pitch 48), settles and squares together, full card 5.0-6.0

M2.desc: welcome mat: armoury, as M1 from higher and steeper (pitch 62)

M3.desc: welcome mat: armoury, as M1 from lower (pitch 34, closer): more cinematic

M4.desc: welcome mat: armoury, as M1 with a wider orbit (yaw -70 -> 0)

M5.desc: welcome mat: armoury, as M1 orbiting from the other corner (yaw +45 -> 0)

M6.desc: welcome mat: inn (one storey, TAV seed 7, no outbuildings), M1's camera, x1.19 so it settles at 4.3 s

M7.desc: welcome mat: armoury, as M1 but the mat spins in like a prop (the house's floor motion, 1.5x slower) from 0.25 s

M8.desc: welcome mat: armoury, as M1 with a slow push-in on the orbit (dist 78 -> 64)

_Mz: ZOOM DEPTH (Harry 2026-10-22): Mn-zK = Mn framed by fraction (shots.json camera.frame) at the end of the orbit, held through it; z1 = Mn itself. The square comes from its own 1080x1080 take (square_capture), framed the same way for the square, not cropped.
